bodeoum_tv.name: Bodeoum TV
bodeoum_tv.triggerDetail: Former employees alleged covert monitoring of staff. Kang issued a 55-minute procedural apology and was later cleared of criminal intent.
bodeoum_tv.outcome: Prosecutors later cleared him of criminal intent. The study's post-apology window begins on July 6, 2024.
bodeoum_tv.apologyTitleEn: I'm sorry it took so long.
bodeoum_tv.transcriptTranslation: Hello. I'm trainer Kang Hyung-wook. Before asking whether the allegations are true, I'm truly sorry for making noise with this news and for bringing you such bad news. I'm someone who should be talking about how to live better with dogs, but I'm sorry for showing you a bad side through actions that fell short.
bodeoum_tv.transcriptNote: The local Whisper transcript mishears “강형욱” as “강영웅” in its first line. Transcripts were collected but not analyzed in the paper.

nodes.text:
마녀사냥 그만하고
그 직원들 얼굴  공개하고  무고죄로
고소해라
지들 비위상한다고
또 누굴  죽이려하는지
강형욱님 힘내세요
nodes.textClean: 마녀사냥 그만하고 그 직원들 얼굴 공개하고 무고죄로 고소해라 지들 비위상한다고 또 누굴 죽이려하는지 강형욱님 힘내세요
nodes.translation: Stop the witch hunt. Make those employees show their faces and sue them for false accusation. Are they trying to destroy someone again just because they're upset? Stay strong, Kang Hyung-wook.

nodes.author: @하은김-i3w
nodes.text: 오해를 풀어야지 언론플레이를해? 얼굴 깔 자신도 없으면서 신상털자 아주 그냥 나락가야 정신차리지
nodes.textClean: 오해를 풀어야지 언론플레이를해? 얼굴 깔 자신도 없으면서 신상털자 아주 그냥 나락가야 정신차리지
nodes.translation: You should clear up the misunderstanding—why play the media game? You don't even have the guts to show your face, so let's dig up identities; they'll only learn after hitting rock bottom.

nodes.author: @조수진-e6n
nodes.text: 무고죄는 아니지 저들내외 잘못있는것고 맞고 그직원 과민진상도 맞고 오해도 있고.
nodes.textClean: 무고죄는 아니지 저들내외 잘못있는것고 맞고 그직원 과민진상도 맞고 오해도 있고.
nodes.translation: It isn't false accusation. The couple were partly at fault, the employee overreacted, and there are misunderstandings on both sides.

nodes.author: @refrigerate_after_opening
nodes.text: 무고로 고소를 못해요. 메신저 훔쳐본 건 사실이라서. 그게 거짓이었으면 무고인데 엄연한 사실이라 무고가 안 됩니다.
nodes.textClean: 무고로 고소를 못해요. 메신저 훔쳐본 건 사실이라서. 그게 거짓이었으면 무고인데 엄연한 사실이라 무고가 안 됩니다.
nodes.translation: They can't sue for false accusation. It's true that he looked through the messenger. If that were false, it would be false accusation—but it's fact, so it isn't.

nodes.author: @어묵-j5v
nodes.text: 그래 빨리 고소하고 누가 진짠지 밝혀졌으면 좋겠다 다들 댓글법정에서 빨거나 헐뜯는 거 없이
nodes.textClean: 그래 빨리 고소하고 누가 진짠지 밝혀졌으면 좋겠다 다들 댓글법정에서 빨거나 헐뜯는 거 없이
nodes.translation: Yes—sue quickly and let the truth come out. No more arguing or tearing people down in the comment-section court.

thread.note: One real thread. The graph on the right keeps only the unique authors and the reply links between them.

sentimentExamples.label: Positive · apology video
sentimentExamples.translation: You must have had a hard time; you did well.
sentimentExamples.note: A short, unambiguous message of support.

sentimentExamples.label: Negative · apology video
sentimentExamples.text: 전문경영이 안되서 생긴거같은데? 사업자로 계약한것도 고용하기 싫어서 그런거같고
sentimentExamples.translation: Seems like this happened because there's no professional management? And I think they used contractor agreements because they didn't want to hire employees.
sentimentExamples.note: Critical of management choices; the model reads the criticism as negative.

sentimentExamples.label: Neutral · apology video
sentimentExamples.translation: If this is true, he's a real malicious narcissist.
sentimentExamples.note: The words are harsh, but the model's confidence falls inside the 0.4–0.6 band, so the final label is NEUTRAL. This is the band doing its job—and also a reminder that NEUTRAL is not a semantic third class.

mimiminu.name: Mimiminu
mimiminu.trigger: Promoted app filed for bankruptcy, trapping student deposits
mimiminu.triggerDetail: Part-time Study, an educational app Miminu promoted, filed for bankruptcy, affecting student deposits. He returned his 100-million KRW advertising fee and contributed an additional amount to a victim fund.
mimiminu.outcome: He continued publishing after the apology. Post-window sentiment stayed above its pre-window level.
mimiminu.apologyTitleEn: I'm sorry for the Part-time Study bankruptcy and deposit delays.
mimiminu.opening: A financial scandal with student victims
mimiminu.transcriptTranslation: Hello. I'm Miminu. On Monday, November 24, the Part-time Study service I advertised on this channel filed for bankruptcy without warning, and many people have been unable to get their deposits back. I turned on the camera to explain my position and what I plan to do. Put simply, I will formally return the entire advertising fee I received, plus an additional amount, to the victims—and I will try to help those who are losing sleep and suffering right now as they face a difficult fight ahead.
mimiminu.transcriptNote: Collected with faster-whisper, locally. The paper uses transcripts as context; it does not run a linguistic analysis of the apology videos.

nodes.translation: This is exactly why he has no choice. Once a few people like you—and others who join just for fun—pile on, how much muddying of the waters will there be?

sentimentExamples.label: Positive · apology video
sentimentExamples.text: 뒤처리 고트네.. 롱런하는 이유가 있어~ 응원해 형
sentimentExamples.translation: The way you handle the aftermath is GOAT-level. There's a reason you last so long. Rooting for you, bro.
sentimentExamples.note: Praise for how he handled the fallout, not for the controversy itself.

sentimentExamples.label: Negative · apology video
sentimentExamples.text: 쓰레기 업체 때문에 대미누 돈 깨지누...
sentimentExamples.translation: Because of a trash company, Miminu is losing money...
sentimentExamples.note: The negative language is aimed at the company, not Miminu. The model scores the surface polarity, not the target of blame.

sentimentExamples.label: Neutral · apology video
sentimentExamples.translation: This is a natural disaster, honestly... ㅠㅠ
sentimentExamples.note: Sympathy mixed with resignation. The confidence lands just above 0.5, inside the NEUTRAL band.

sentimentExamples.label: Positive · after the apology
sentimentExamples.text:
미누님 항상 응원합니다
다사다난한 한해였지만 그 자체로도 미누님은 대체 불가능한 존재입니다! 이미 많은 한계들을 넘으셨기에 앞으로 그 한계를 넘는게 점점 힘들고 어려울거 깉아요ㅠㅠ 앞으로도 항상 응원합니다
sentimentExamples.translation: Always rooting for you, Miminu. It's been a turbulent year, but you're irreplaceable in your own right. You've already crossed so many limits that the next ones will be even harder—but I'll always root for you.
sentimentExamples.note: A long-term viewer message. Length does not change the label, but the model reads the closing support clearly.

rawComment.author: @Saturdayq
rawComment.text: 가해자가 해야할 보상을 왜 모델이 함? 이걸로 가해자의 책임이 가벼워지지 않길

transcript.text:
안녕하세요. 미이미누입니다.
제 채널에서 광고를 진행했던 파트타임 스터디 서비스가
11월 24일 월요일 아무런 예고도 없이 갑작스럽게 파산 신청을 해서
많은 분들이 보증금을 환급받지 못하고 있는 현 상황에 대해
저의 입장과 대응 방안을 직접 전달드리고자 카메라를 켜게 되었습니다.
결론부터 말씀드리면 제가 받았던 광고비 전액과 추가적인 금액을
피해자분들에게 정식으로 전달해서
지금 이 순간에도 잠 못 이루고 마음고생을 하고 계실 분들이
앞으로 쉽지 않은 싸움을 해나가는데 조금이나마 보탬이 되도록 노력하겠습니다.
transcript.translation: Hello. I'm Miminu. On Monday, November 24, the Part-time Study service I advertised on this channel filed for bankruptcy without warning, and many people have been unable to get their deposits back. I turned on the camera to explain my position and what I plan to do. Put simply, I will formally return the entire advertising fee I received, plus an additional amount, to the victims—and I will try to help those who are losing sleep and suffering right now as they face a difficult fight ahead.
transcript.note: Collected with faster-whisper, locally. The paper uses transcripts as context; it does not run a linguistic analysis of the apology videos.

apology.title: ‘파트타임스터디’ 파산 및 보증금 반환 지연에 사과드립니다
apology.titleEn: I’m sorry for the Part-time Study bankruptcy and delayed deposit refunds.

shapiro.note: Shapiro–Wilk on a 5,000-comment random sample; the paper reports non-normal windows for both cases (p < 0.001).
